## Description of Changes

A concise description of what this PR implements, modifies, or fixes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to PSR-12 and existing project coding conventions.
- [ ] I have verified that no sensitive credentials, internal IPs, or secrets are committed.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests covering the new functionality.
- [ ] All tests pass cleanly (`composer test`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/` or `README.md`.
